test_cases:
N, J, Jz, hz = 4, 1.0, 0.3, 1.0
assert np.allclose(lfxxz_terms(N, J, Jz, hz), target)

N, J, Jz, hz = 3, 0.5, 0.1, 0.0
assert np.allclose(lfxxz_terms(N, J, Jz, hz), target)

N, J, Jz, hz = 5, 1.0, 1.0, 0.25
assert np.allclose(lfxxz_terms(N, J, Jz, hz), target)

terms = np.array([[3.0, 0.7], [15.0, -0.2], [2.0, 1.0]])
N = 2
assert np.allclose(doubled_terms(terms, N), target)

psi = np.zeros(16, dtype=complex)
psi[0] = 0.6
psi[5] = 0.8j
M = 4
assert np.allclose(pauli_expectations(psi, M), target)

psi = np.ones(4, dtype=complex) / 2.0
M = 2
assert np.allclose(pauli_expectations(psi, M), target)

terms = np.array([[5.0, 0.5], [15.0, 0.5], [10.0, 0.1], [20.0, 0.5], [60.0, 0.5], [40.0, 0.1], [2.0, 0.0], [8.0, 0.0], [32.0, 0.0]], dtype=np.float64)
M = 3
psi0 = np.zeros(8, dtype=complex)
psi0[3] = 1.0
obs = 2 + 2 * 4
ts = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 5.0])
assert np.allclose(exact_observable_series(terms, M, psi0, obs, ts), target)

N, J, Jz, hz, beta, w_site, v_site = 4, 1.0, 0.3, 1.0, 2.0, 1, 1
eps1, eps2, tol, kmax, t_final, dt = 0.02, 1e-6, 1e-12, 100, 2.5, 0.1
assert np.allclose(pruned_otoc(N, J, Jz, hz, beta, w_site, v_site, eps1, eps2, tol, kmax, t_final, dt), target)

N, J, Jz, hz, beta, w_site, v_site = 4, 1.0, 0.3, 1.0, 2.0, 1, 1
eps1, eps2, tol, kmax, t_final, dt = 0.02, 1e-6, 1e-12, 100, 2.5, 0.1
t_final = 1.5
assert np.allclose(pruned_otoc(N, J, Jz, hz, beta, w_site, v_site, eps1, eps2, tol, kmax, t_final, dt), target)

N, J, Jz, hz, beta, w_site, v_site = 4, 1.0, 0.3, 1.0, 2.0, 1, 1
eps1, eps2, tol, kmax, t_final, dt = 0.02, 1e-6, 1e-12, 100, 2.5, 0.1
eps2 = 1e-3
beta = 1.0
assert np.allclose(pruned_otoc(N, J, Jz, hz, beta, w_site, v_site, eps1, eps2, tol, kmax, t_final, dt), target)
